</details>


### Steps to reproduce issue

1. Launch file with a given namespace and a configuration file:
```py
  my_container = ComposableNodeContainer(
        name='my_container',
        namespace=namespace,
        package='rclcpp_components',
        executable='component_container',
        output='screen',
        composable_node_descriptions=[
            ComposableNode(
                package='my_package',
                plugin='my_plugin',
                name='node_name',
                namespace=namespace,
                parameters=[
                    config,
                    {'use_sim_time': use_sim_time},
                ],
                remappings=[
                    ('/tf', 'tf'),
                    ('/tf_static', 'tf_static'),
                    ('/my_topic', 'my_topic_remapped'),
                ],
            ),
        ],
    )
```
2. Launch the file and inspect the list of topics using `ros2 topic list`.

### Expected behavior

We should see the tf topics properly namespaced by inspecting the output of `ros2 topic list`.
```bash
/namespace/tf
/namespace/tf_static
/namespace/my_topic_remapped
```

### Actual behavior

The node specific topics are properly namespaced but tf related ones are not.
```bash
/tf
/tf_static
/namespace/my_topic_remapped
```

### Additional information

The way I got it to work work is by adding the tf remapping in the **container node** rather than in the **composable node** itself.
```py
    my_container = ComposableNodeContainer(
        name='my_container',
        namespace=namespace,
        package='rclcpp_components',
        executable='component_container',
        output='screen',
        remappings=[
            ('/tf', 'tf'),
            ('/tf_static', 'tf_static'),
        ],
        composable_node_descriptions=[
            ComposableNode(
                package='my_package',
                plugin='my_plugin',
                name='node_name',
                namespace=namespace,
                parameters=[
                    config,
                    {'use_sim_time': use_sim_time},
                ],
                remappings=[
                    ('my_topic', 'my_topic_remapped'),
                ],
            ),
        ],
    )
```

@wjwwood I discovered something interesting while debugging this issue.

When a component loaded into a container subscribes (**tf listener**) to `tf` or `tf_static`, the resulting TF topics are **not namespaced correctly**. The node ends up receiving TF messages from the global (`/tf,` `/tf_static`) namespace instead of the container’s expected namespace.

However, the behavior is different when the same component publishes (**tf broadcaster**) to `tf` or `tf_static`:
in that case, the TF topics are namespaced correctly (e.g.` <container_ns>/tf` and `<container_ns>/tf_static`).

So the inconsistency only appears on the subscriber side of TF topics inside a component container. For the subscriber case, here are the requested outputs:

* Topic list:

```bash
$ ros2 topic list
/parameter_events
/rosout
/test_ns/my_topic_remapped
/tf
/tf_static
```

To test and reproduce this I wrote some easy/dummy components:

  • my_broadcaster_component.hpp
#pragma once

#include <rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp>
#include <std_msgs/msg/bool.hpp>
#include <tf2_ros/static_transform_broadcaster.h>
#include <tf2_ros/transform_broadcaster.h>

namespace rclcpp_component_bug
{

class MyBroadcasterComponent : public rclcpp::Node
{
public:
  explicit MyBroadcasterComponent(const rclcpp::NodeOptions& options = rclcpp::NodeOptions());

private:
  void on_timer();
  void topic_callback(const std_msgs::msg::Bool & msg) const;

  rclcpp::TimerBase::SharedPtr timer_;
  std::unique_ptr<tf2_ros::TransformBroadcaster> tf_broadcaster_;
  std::unique_ptr<tf2_ros::StaticTransformBroadcaster> static_tf_broadcaster_;
  rclcpp::Subscription<std_msgs::msg::Bool>::SharedPtr sub_;
};

}  // namespace rclcpp_component_bug
  • my_broadcaster_component.cpp
#include <chrono>

#include <geometry_msgs/msg/transform_stamped.hpp>
#include <rclcpp_components/register_node_macro.hpp>

#include "rclcpp_component_bug/my_broadcaster_component.hpp"

using namespace std::chrono_literals;

namespace rclcpp_component_bug
{

MyBroadcasterComponent::MyBroadcasterComponent(const rclcpp::NodeOptions & options)
: Node("my_broadcaster_component", options)
{
  // Publishers for TF topics
  tf_broadcaster_ = std::make_unique<tf2_ros::TransformBroadcaster>(*this);
  static_tf_broadcaster_ = std::make_unique<tf2_ros::StaticTransformBroadcaster>(*this);

  // Subscriber for a regular topic
  sub_ = this->create_subscription<std_msgs::msg::Bool>(
    "my_topic", 10, std::bind(&MyBroadcasterComponent::topic_callback, this, std::placeholders::_1));

  // Publish a static transform once
  geometry_msgs::msg::TransformStamped static_t;
  static_t.header.stamp = this->get_clock()->now();
  static_t.header.frame_id = "world";
  static_t.child_frame_id = "static_frame";
  static_t.transform.translation.x = 1.0;
  static_t.transform.rotation.w = 1.0;
  static_tf_broadcaster_->sendTransform(static_t);

  // Publish dynamic transforms periodically
  timer_ = this->create_wall_timer(500ms, std::bind(&MyBroadcasterComponent::on_timer, this));

  RCLCPP_INFO(this->get_logger(), "MyBroadcasterComponent started.");
}

void MyBroadcasterComponent::on_timer()
{
  geometry_msgs::msg::TransformStamped t;

  t.header.stamp = this->get_clock()->now();
  t.header.frame_id = "world";
  t.child_frame_id = "dynamic_frame";

  t.transform.translation.x = 1.0 * sin(this->get_clock()->now().seconds());
  t.transform.translation.y = 1.0 * cos(this->get_clock()->now().seconds());
  t.transform.translation.z = 0.0;
  t.transform.rotation.w = 1.0;

  tf_broadcaster_->sendTransform(t);
}

void MyBroadcasterComponent::topic_callback(const std_msgs::msg::Bool & msg) const
{
  RCLCPP_INFO(
    this->get_logger(), "Received message: %s", msg.data ? "true" : "false");
}

}  // namespace rclcpp_component_bug

RCLCPP_COMPONENTS_REGISTER_NODE(rclcpp_component_bug::MyBroadcasterComponent)

#include <rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp>

namespace rclcpp_component_bug
{

class MyListenerComponent : public rclcpp::Node
{
public:
  explicit MyListenerComponent(const rclcpp::NodeOptions& options = rclcpp::NodeOptions());

private:
  void on_timer();
  void topic_callback(const std_msgs::msg::Bool & msg) const;

  rclcpp::TimerBase::SharedPtr timer_;
  std::shared_ptr<tf2_ros::TransformListener> tf_listener_{nullptr};
  std::unique_ptr<tf2_ros::Buffer> tf_buffer_{nullptr};
  rclcpp::Subscription<std_msgs::msg::Bool>::SharedPtr sub_;
};

}  // namespace rclcpp_component_bug
  • my_listener_component.cpp
#include <chrono>

#include <geometry_msgs/msg/transform_stamped.hpp>
#include <rclcpp_components/register_node_macro.hpp>

#include "rclcpp_component_bug/my_listener_component.hpp"

using namespace std::chrono_literals;

namespace rclcpp_component_bug
{

MyListenerComponent::MyListenerComponent(const rclcpp::NodeOptions & options)
: Node("tf_listener_bug_component", options)
{
  // Setup Tf
  tf_buffer_ = std::make_unique<tf2_ros::Buffer>(this->get_clock());
  tf_listener_ = std::make_shared<tf2_ros::TransformListener>(*tf_buffer_);

  // Subscriber for a regular topic
  sub_ = this->create_subscription<std_msgs::msg::Bool>(
    "my_topic", 10, std::bind(&MyListenerComponent::topic_callback, this, std::placeholders::_1));

  // Publish dynamic transforms periodically
  timer_ = this->create_wall_timer(1000ms, std::bind(&MyListenerComponent::on_timer, this));

  RCLCPP_INFO(this->get_logger(), "MyListenerComponent started.");
}

void MyListenerComponent::on_timer()
{
  try {
    geometry_msgs::msg::TransformStamped transformStamped = tf_buffer_->lookupTransform(
      "world", "dynamic_frame", tf2::TimePointZero);
    RCLCPP_INFO(
      this->get_logger(),
      "Transform received: translation(%.2f, %.2f, %.2f)",
      transformStamped.transform.translation.x,
      transformStamped.transform.translation.y,
      transformStamped.transform.translation.z);
  } catch (tf2::TransformException & ex) {
    RCLCPP_WARN(this->get_logger(), "Could not get transform: %s", ex.what());
  }
}

void MyListenerComponent::topic_callback(const std_msgs::msg::Bool & msg) const
{
  RCLCPP_INFO(
    this->get_logger(), "Received message: %s", msg.data ? "true" : "false");
}

}  // namespace rclcpp_component_bug

RCLCPP_COMPONENTS_REGISTER_NODE(rclcpp_component_bug::MyListenerComponent)

from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import DeclareLaunchArgument
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.actions import ComposableNodeContainer
from launch_ros.descriptions import ComposableNode


def generate_launch_description():
    """Launch file to reproduce the tf remapping bug."""
    namespace_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument(
        'namespace', default_value='test_ns',
        description='Namespace for the container and node.'
    )

    namespace = LaunchConfiguration('namespace')

    # This configuration demonstrates the bug.
    # The remappings for /tf and /tf_static are inside the ComposableNode.
    # Expected: /test_ns/tf, /test_ns/tf_static, /test_ns/my_topic_remapped
    # Actual: /tf, /tf_static, /test_ns/my_topic_remapped
    my_container = ComposableNodeContainer(
        name='my_container',
        namespace=namespace,
        package='rclcpp_components',
        executable='component_container',
        output='screen',
        composable_node_descriptions=[
            ComposableNode(
                package='rclcpp_component_bug',
                plugin='rclcpp_component_bug::MyListenerComponent',
                name='my_listener_component',
                namespace=namespace,
                remappings=[
                    # These remappings do not get namespaced correctly
                    ('/tf', 'tf'),
                    ('/tf_static', 'tf_static'),
                    # This remapping works as expected
                    ('my_topic', 'my_topic_remapped'),
                ],
            ),
        ],
    )

    return LaunchDescription([
        namespace_arg,
        my_container,
    ])

Thanks for posting the code! I see you're using the `TransformListener(buffer)` constructor. [This constructor internally creates a new ROS 2 node](https://github.com/ros2/geometry2/blob/5b843f5c5ec432fd9f2e1accb1616659cb6ad288/tf2_ros/include/tf2_ros/transform_listener.hpp#L103-L111). I think what's happening is the Composable node container passes the remap arguments via `NodeOptions` into `MyListenerComponent`, but those options aren't being forwarded to `TransformListener`'s internal node.

I recommend using [`TransformListener`'s "NodeInterfaces" constructor (ROS Jazzy version)](https://github.com/ros2/geometry2/blob/8362467aaae7cc161a78ca43381bdbe3992172e1/tf2_ros/include/tf2_ros/transform_listener.hpp#L123-L148) instead. That should make `TransformListener` use your existing node instead of creating a new one, and so the remap arguments given to your existing node will apply to the `/tf` topics.

@sloretz Thanks a lot for your response and time, you've hit the nail on the head!

Changing 
```cpp
tf_listener_ = std::make_shared<tf2_ros::TransformListener>(*tf_buffer_);
```
to 
```
tf_listener_ = std::make_shared<tf2_ros::TransformListener>(*tf_buffer_, this);
```

solved the issue.

@wjwwood I discovered something interesting while debugging this issue.

When a component loaded into a container subscribes (**tf listener**) to `tf` or `tf_static`, the resulting TF topics are **not namespaced correctly**. The node ends up receiving TF messages from the global (`/tf,` `/tf_static`) namespace instead of the container’s expected namespace.

However, the behavior is different when the same component publishes (**tf broadcaster**) to `tf` or `tf_static`:
in that case, the TF topics are namespaced correctly (e.g.` <container_ns>/tf` and `<container_ns>/tf_static`).

#pragma once

#include <rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp>
#include <std_msgs/msg/bool.hpp>
#include <tf2_ros/static_transform_broadcaster.h>
#include <tf2_ros/transform_broadcaster.h>

namespace rclcpp_component_bug
{

class MyBroadcasterComponent : public rclcpp::Node
{
public:
  explicit MyBroadcasterComponent(const rclcpp::NodeOptions& options = rclcpp::NodeOptions());

private:
  void on_timer();
  void topic_callback(const std_msgs::msg::Bool & msg) const;

  rclcpp::TimerBase::SharedPtr timer_;
  std::unique_ptr<tf2_ros::TransformBroadcaster> tf_broadcaster_;
  std::unique_ptr<tf2_ros::StaticTransformBroadcaster> static_tf_broadcaster_;
  rclcpp::Subscription<std_msgs::msg::Bool>::SharedPtr sub_;
};

}  // namespace rclcpp_component_bug
  • my_broadcaster_component.cpp
#include <chrono>

#include <geometry_msgs/msg/transform_stamped.hpp>
#include <rclcpp_components/register_node_macro.hpp>

#include "rclcpp_component_bug/my_broadcaster_component.hpp"

using namespace std::chrono_literals;

namespace rclcpp_component_bug
{

MyBroadcasterComponent::MyBroadcasterComponent(const rclcpp::NodeOptions & options)
: Node("my_broadcaster_component", options)
{
  // Publishers for TF topics
  tf_broadcaster_ = std::make_unique<tf2_ros::TransformBroadcaster>(*this);
  static_tf_broadcaster_ = std::make_unique<tf2_ros::StaticTransformBroadcaster>(*this);

  // Subscriber for a regular topic
  sub_ = this->create_subscription<std_msgs::msg::Bool>(
    "my_topic", 10, std::bind(&MyBroadcasterComponent::topic_callback, this, std::placeholders::_1));

  // Publish a static transform once
  geometry_msgs::msg::TransformStamped static_t;
  static_t.header.stamp = this->get_clock()->now();
  static_t.header.frame_id = "world";
  static_t.child_frame_id = "static_frame";
  static_t.transform.translation.x = 1.0;
  static_t.transform.rotation.w = 1.0;
  static_tf_broadcaster_->sendTransform(static_t);

  // Publish dynamic transforms periodically
  timer_ = this->create_wall_timer(500ms, std::bind(&MyBroadcasterComponent::on_timer, this));

  RCLCPP_INFO(this->get_logger(), "MyBroadcasterComponent started.");
}

void MyBroadcasterComponent::on_timer()
{
  geometry_msgs::msg::TransformStamped t;

  t.header.stamp = this->get_clock()->now();
  t.header.frame_id = "world";
  t.child_frame_id = "dynamic_frame";

  t.transform.translation.x = 1.0 * sin(this->get_clock()->now().seconds());
  t.transform.translation.y = 1.0 * cos(this->get_clock()->now().seconds());
  t.transform.translation.z = 0.0;
  t.transform.rotation.w = 1.0;

  tf_broadcaster_->sendTransform(t);
}

void MyBroadcasterComponent::topic_callback(const std_msgs::msg::Bool & msg) const
{
  RCLCPP_INFO(
    this->get_logger(), "Received message: %s", msg.data ? "true" : "false");
}

}  // namespace rclcpp_component_bug

RCLCPP_COMPONENTS_REGISTER_NODE(rclcpp_component_bug::MyBroadcasterComponent)

#include <chrono>

#include <geometry_msgs/msg/transform_stamped.hpp>
#include <rclcpp_components/register_node_macro.hpp>

#include "rclcpp_component_bug/my_listener_component.hpp"

using namespace std::chrono_literals;

namespace rclcpp_component_bug
{

MyListenerComponent::MyListenerComponent(const rclcpp::NodeOptions & options)
: Node("tf_listener_bug_component", options)
{
  // Setup Tf
  tf_buffer_ = std::make_unique<tf2_ros::Buffer>(this->get_clock());
  tf_listener_ = std::make_shared<tf2_ros::TransformListener>(*tf_buffer_);

  // Subscriber for a regular topic
  sub_ = this->create_subscription<std_msgs::msg::Bool>(
    "my_topic", 10, std::bind(&MyListenerComponent::topic_callback, this, std::placeholders::_1));

  // Publish dynamic transforms periodically
  timer_ = this->create_wall_timer(1000ms, std::bind(&MyListenerComponent::on_timer, this));

  RCLCPP_INFO(this->get_logger(), "MyListenerComponent started.");
}

void MyListenerComponent::on_timer()
{
  try {
    geometry_msgs::msg::TransformStamped transformStamped = tf_buffer_->lookupTransform(
      "world", "dynamic_frame", tf2::TimePointZero);
    RCLCPP_INFO(
      this->get_logger(),
      "Transform received: translation(%.2f, %.2f, %.2f)",
      transformStamped.transform.translation.x,
      transformStamped.transform.translation.y,
      transformStamped.transform.translation.z);
  } catch (tf2::TransformException & ex) {
    RCLCPP_WARN(this->get_logger(), "Could not get transform: %s", ex.what());
  }
}

void MyListenerComponent::topic_callback(const std_msgs::msg::Bool & msg) const
{
  RCLCPP_INFO(
    this->get_logger(), "Received message: %s", msg.data ? "true" : "false");
}

from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import DeclareLaunchArgument
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.actions import ComposableNodeContainer
from launch_ros.descriptions import ComposableNode


def generate_launch_description():
    """Launch file to reproduce the tf remapping bug."""
    namespace_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument(
        'namespace', default_value='test_ns',
        description='Namespace for the container and node.'
    )

    namespace = LaunchConfiguration('namespace')

    # This configuration demonstrates the bug.
    # The remappings for /tf and /tf_static are inside the ComposableNode.
    # Expected: /test_ns/tf, /test_ns/tf_static, /test_ns/my_topic_remapped
    # Actual: /tf, /tf_static, /test_ns/my_topic_remapped
    my_container = ComposableNodeContainer(
        name='my_container',
        namespace=namespace,
        package='rclcpp_components',
        executable='component_container',
        output='screen',
        composable_node_descriptions=[
            ComposableNode(
                package='rclcpp_component_bug',
                plugin='rclcpp_component_bug::MyListenerComponent',
                name='my_listener_component',
                namespace=namespace,
                remappings=[
                    # These remappings do not get namespaced correctly
                    ('/tf', 'tf'),
                    ('/tf_static', 'tf_static'),
                    # This remapping works as expected
                    ('my_topic', 'my_topic_remapped'),
                ],
            ),
        ],
    )

    return LaunchDescription([
        namespace_arg,
        my_container,
    ])

Thanks for posting the code! I see you're using the `TransformListener(buffer)` constructor. [This constructor internally creates a new ROS 2 node](https://github.com/ros2/geometry2/blob/5b843f5c5ec432fd9f2e1accb1616659cb6ad288/tf2_ros/include/tf2_ros/transform_listener.hpp#L103-L111). I think what's happening is the Composable node container passes the remap arguments via `NodeOptions` into `MyListenerComponent`, but those options aren't being forwarded to `TransformListener`'s internal node.

I recommend using [`TransformListener`'s "NodeInterfaces" constructor (ROS Jazzy version)](https://github.com/ros2/geometry2/blob/8362467aaae7cc161a78ca43381bdbe3992172e1/tf2_ros/include/tf2_ros/transform_listener.hpp#L123-L148) instead. That should make `TransformListener` use your existing node instead of creating a new one, and so the remap arguments given to your existing node will apply to the `/tf` topics.

@sloretz Thanks a lot for your response and time, you've hit the nail on the head!

Changing 
```cpp
tf_listener_ = std::make_shared<tf2_ros::TransformListener>(*tf_buffer_);
```
to 
```
tf_listener_ = std::make_shared<tf2_ros::TransformListener>(*tf_buffer_, this);
```
solved the issue.

I think this is an important takeaway that could be added to the documentation here (e.g. https://docs.ros.org/en/jazzy/Tutorials/Intermediate/Tf2/Writing-A-Tf2-Listener-Cpp.html) so users are aware of the internal-node behavior of the default constructor, especially when using composable nodes.
